topic: Significance and Layers of the Sun
key_concepts: The Sun is the largest object in the solar system and the nearest star to Earth
Studying the Sun helps scientists understand other stars in the Milky Way galaxy
Studying the Sun helps scientists understand stellar objects in other galaxies

The Sun is the source of energy for all life forms
Excessive energy from the Sun can disturb Earth's near-space environment
Solar disturbances can disrupt communication systems and damage spacecraft
Astronauts can be endangered by explosive solar phenomena
Understanding solar dynamics can help create early warning systems for eruptive events
Nuclear fusion reactions occur inside the Sun
The Sun is about 4.5 billion years old
